newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk end-Nov domestic debt up to 2,958 trln lira.
newsitem.headline: Turk end-Nov domestic debt up to 2,958 trln lira.

text.p: Turkey's outstanding domestic debt at end-November rose to 2,958 trillion lira from 2,891 trillion lira at end-October and 1,361 trillion at end-1995, the treasury said on Monday.

It said the end-November debt included 1,746 trillion lira of treasury bills with less than one-year maturity, 995.8 trillion lira of government bonds with at least one year maturity and 216.1 trillion lira of central bank advances.
